tha-ap492:1.1: Sālamaṇḍapiya.] Ajjhogahetvā sālavanaṃ sukato assamo mama / sālapupphehi sañchanno vasāmi pavane tadā. // //
tha-ap492:2.1: Piyadassī ca bhagavā sayambhū aggapuggalo / vivekakāmo sambuddho sālavanam upāgami. // //
tha-ap492:3.1: Assamā abhinikkhamma pavanaṃ agamās' ahaṃ / mūlaphalaṃ gavesanto *āhiṇḍāmi vane tadā. // //
tha-ap492:4.1: Tatthā*ddasāsiṃ sambuddhaṃ Piyadassiṃ mahāyasaṃ / sunisinnaṃ samāpannaṃ virocantaṃ mahāvane. // //
tha-ap492:5.1: Catudaṇḍe ṭhapetvāna Buddhassa uparī ahaṃ / maṇḍapaṃ sukataṃ katvā sālap*upphehi chādayiṃ* // //
tha-ap492:6.1: Sattā*haṃ dhārayitvāna maṇḍapaṃ sālachāditaṃ / tattha* cittaṃ pasādetvā Buddhaseṭṭhaṃ avandi 'haṃ. // //
tha-ap492:7.1: Bhagavā tamhi samaye vuṭṭhahitvā samādhino / yugamattaṃ pekkhamāno nisīdi purisuttamo. // //
tha-ap492:8.1: Sāvako Varuṇo nāma Piyadassissa satthuno / vasīsatasahassehi upāgacchi vināyakaṃ. // //
tha-ap492:9.1: Piyadassī tu bhagavā lokajeṭṭho narāsabho / bhikkhusaṅghe nisīditvā sitaṃ pātukarī jino. // //
tha-ap492:10.1: Anuruddho upaṭṭhāko Piyadassissa satthuno / ekaṃsaṃ cīvaraṃ katvā apucchittha mahāmuniṃ: // //
tha-ap492:11.1: ‘Ko nu kho bhagavā hetu sitakammassa satthuno / kāraṇe vijjamānamhi satthā pātukaresi taṃ?' // //
tha-ap492:12.1: Sattāhaṃ pupphachadanaṃ yo me dhāresi māṇavo / tassa kammaṃ saritvāna sitaṃ pātukariṃ ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap492:13.1: Okāsāhaṃ na passāmi yan taṃ puññaṃ vipaccati / devaloke manusse vā okāso ca na sammati. // //
tha-ap492:14.1: Devaloke vasantassa puññakammasamaṅgino / yāvatā parisā tassa sālacchannā bhavissati. // //
tha-ap492:15.1: Tattha dibbehi naccehi gītehi vāditehi ca / ramissati tadā santo puññakammasamāhito. // //
tha-ap492:16.1: Yāvatā parisā tassa gandhagandhī bhavissati / sālassa pupphavasso ca pavassissati tāvade. // //
tha-ap492:17.1: Tato cuto yaṃ manujo mānusaṃ agamissati / idhāpi sālacchadanaṃ sabbakālaṃ dhariyyati // //
tha-ap492:18.1: Idha naccañ ca gītañ ca samatālasamāhitaṃ / parivāressant' imaṃ niccaṃ Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ // //
tha-ap492:19.1: Uggacchante ca suriye sālavassaṃ pavassati / puññakammena sanyuttaṃ vassate sabbakālikaṃ. // //
tha-ap492:20.1: Aṭṭhārase kappasate Okkākakulasambhavo / Gotamo nāma nāmena satthā loke bhavissati. // //
tha-ap492:21.1: Tassa dhammesu dāyādo oraso dhammanimmito / sabbāsave pariññāya nibbāyissat' anāsavo. // //
tha-ap492:22.1: Dhammaṃ abhisamentassa sālacchadanaṃ bhavissati / citake jhāyamānassa chadanaṃ tattha hessati // //
tha-ap492:23.1: Vipākaṃ kittayitvāna Piyadassī mahāmuni / parisāya dhammaṃ desesi tappento dhammavuṭṭhiyā. // //
tha-ap492:24.1: Tiṃsakappāni devesu devarajjam akārayiṃ / saṭṭhiñ ca catukkhattuñ ca cakkavattī ahos' ahaṃ // //
tha-ap492:25.1: Devalokā idhāgantvā labhāmi vipulaṃ sukhaṃ / idhāpi sālacchadanaṃ maṇḍapassa idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap492:26.1: Ayaṃ pacchimako mayhaṃ carimo vattate bhavo / idhāpi sālacchadanaṃ hessati sabbakālikaṃ. // //
tha-ap492:27.1: Mahāmuniṃ tosayitvā Gotamaṃ Sakyapuṅgavaṃ / patto 'mhi acalaṃ ṭhānaṃ hitvā jayaparājayaṃ. // //
tha-ap492:28.1: *Aṭṭhārase* kappasate yaṃ Buddham abhipūjayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap492:32.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Sālamaṇḍapiyo thero i. g. a-ti.
tha-ap492:36.1: Paṃsukūla-Buddhasaññī Bhisado Ñāṇakittako Candanī Dhātupūjī ca Puliṇuppādako pi ca.
tha-ap492:37.1: Taraṇo Dhammaruciko Sālamaṇḍapiyo tathā gāthā satāni dve honti ūnavīsatimeva ca.
